informal_statement: For every real r,m, the map z maps to z exp(i m/r) is an isometry of the complex plane.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:315-322, the source contract is `lemma isometry_unitCircleArcRotation (r m : ℝ) : Isometry (unitCircleArcRotation r m)`. The circle path is r*exp(i*s/r): s is the signed arclength parameter, not the central angle, and r is not fixed to one. The author preserves the stated radius/span assumptions and, for partition formulas, the stated index and N=0 conventions.
